scheme_name: Financial Assistance to Physically/Mentally Disabled Children of Beneficiary (CBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a registered construction worker under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965 and must have regular contributions received by the Board
Child must have a disability of 40% or more
Benefit is limited to a maximum of two children per beneficiary
Applicant must have been a member of the Board for at least six months before availing the benefit
benefits_summary: ₹1000 per month per eligible child, up to two children, payable until the child’s death.
